content: Zod v4 (current, 57% smaller than v3, includes a 'zod/mini' build ~3.9KB gzip) vs Valibot v1.4.2 (current, tree-shakeable functional API, ~1.4KB gzip for typical schemas). Valibot is meaningfully smaller and more tree-shakeable due to its pipe()-composed function design; Zod has a more ergonomic chained-method API and larger ecosystem/community familiarity. For a small static site validating ~6 known content files at load time, either is technically sufficient; bundle-size difference (roughly 10x) matters more for high-traffic edge/serverless bundles than for a portfolio site, but Zod's ecosystem maturity and simpler mental model favor it for a solo, non-framework-locked project.
